# SHAD metric dictionary

The 171 dimensions of every SHAD series, in the column order of the CSV files.
Each dimension `<name>` has a per-dimension label column `label_<name>`.
*Generated by `Scripts/build_site_data.py`.*

## Platform level (cluster aggregates) - 17 dimensions

| # | Column | Store | Device | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `cpu_usage_ratio` |  |  | ratio | Fraction of CPU time not idle, averaged across all servers. |
| 2 | `cpu_load_ratio` |  |  | ratio | CPU load average across all servers, normalised by CPU count. Can exceed 1.0 when the run queue is longer than the CPU count. |
| 3 | `memory_usage_ratio` |  |  | ratio | Fraction of total used memory, averaged across all servers. |
| 4 | `network_in_bytes` |  |  | bytes/s | Sum of incoming network throughput across all interfaces of all servers (S3 traffic, inter-node traffic, monitoring, ...). |
| 5 | `network_out_bytes` |  |  | bytes/s | Sum of outgoing network throughput across all interfaces of all servers (S3 traffic, inter-node traffic, monitoring, ...). |
| 6 | `objects_count` |  |  | count | Number of objects stored on the RING, including replicas. |
| 7 | `objects_unique_count` |  |  | count | Number of unique (logical) objects stored on the RING, regardless of replica count. |
| 8 | `objects_missing_count` |  |  | count | Number of objects with missing or out-of-service chunks. |
| 9 | `capacity_disk_unique_tb` |  |  | TB | Total stored data of unique objects before replication (logical data size). |
| 10 | `capacity_disk_stored_tb` |  |  | TB | Total stored data including replicas. |
| 11 | `capacity_disk_used_tb` |  |  | TB | Total disk space actually consumed, including overheads beyond stored object sizes. |
| 12 | `capacity_disk_available_tb` |  |  | TB | Total free disk space on the RING. |
| 13 | `capacity_disk_total_tb` |  |  | TB | Total physical disk capacity. Static unless disks are removed from the RING. |
| 14 | `disk_read_bytes` |  |  | bytes/s | Total disk read throughput summed across all disks. |
| 15 | `disk_write_bytes` |  |  | bytes/s | Total disk write throughput summed across all disks. |
| 16 | `disk_io_time_seconds` |  |  | s/s | Fraction of time spent on I/O averaged across all disks. 1.0 means fully saturated. |
| 17 | `disk_errors_count` |  |  | count | Overall error count across all disks. |

## S3 connector / application level - 13 dimensions

| # | Column | Store | Device | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 18 | `s3_errors_5xx` |  |  | errors/s | Rate of HTTP 5xx server errors across all S3 services. |
| 19 | `s3_request_get_operations` |  |  | ops/s | GET request rate. |
| 20 | `s3_request_post_operations` |  |  | ops/s | POST request rate (near constant: the nominal workload does not use multipart uploads). |
| 21 | `s3_request_put_operations` |  |  | ops/s | PUT request rate. |
| 22 | `s3_request_delete_operations` |  |  | ops/s | DELETE request rate. |
| 23 | `s3_request_head_operations` |  |  | ops/s | HEAD request rate (metadata lookups). |
| 24 | `s3_throughput_in_bytes` |  |  | bytes/s | Client-to-S3 data rate. |
| 25 | `s3_throughput_out_bytes` |  |  | bytes/s | S3-to-client data rate (dominates throughput_in in the GET-heavy workload). |
| 26 | `s3_request_get_latency` |  |  | s | 95th percentile GET request duration. |
| 27 | `s3_request_post_latency` |  |  | s | 95th percentile POST request duration. Near constant in the nominal workload. |
| 28 | `s3_request_put_latency` |  |  | s | 95th percentile PUT request duration. |
| 29 | `s3_request_delete_latency` |  |  | s | 95th percentile DELETE request duration. |
| 30 | `s3_request_head_latency` |  |  | s | 95th percentile HEAD request duration. |
